clause: Vector symbol source binding to design-system [STU-VEC-058]

scope.summary: Bind vector geometry as valid symbol source to the design-system domain (14.10) StudioComponent/StudioComponentInstance and honor per-instance override/sync behavior defined there WITHOUT forking a parallel symbol model; isolation-mode editing of a symbol master propagates to synced instances through that domain's contract.
acceptance_criteria: vector geometry as StudioComponent source; instance override/sync honored; no forked model
expected_tests: test: vector geometry valid as StudioComponent source; master edit propagates to synced instances; no forked symbol model

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Forked symbol model; instance sync broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
